name: Community Integrity Budget System
purpose: Convert verified recovery and savings into a structured reinvestment plan that restores community stability, rights enforcement, and economic participation.
description: CIBS receives modeled recovery from CIRI and allocates it across public-facing community priorities using transparent percentage-based budgeting. It forms the visible reinvestment layer of A.B.E.
formula_overview: Recovery Pool = Direct + Indirect + Deferred Savings - Transition Costs

inputs.name: ciri_artifact
inputs.description: Recovery output including modeled savings, restored participation, and avoided harm.

inputs.name: inputs_csv
inputs.description: Optional uploaded or local scenario input file.

inputs.name: budget_template_csv
inputs.description: Optional budget template for scenario modeling.

inputs.name: auto_budget_csv
inputs.description: Optional prebuilt budget structure for automated allocation.

outputs.name: available_budget
outputs.description: Total recovery pool available for reinvestment.

outputs.name: total_percent
outputs.description: Total percentage represented in the allocation model.

outputs.name: program_count
outputs.description: Number of active funded allocation categories.

allocation_framework.purpose: Keep families stable and stop generational collapse.
Restore equal opportunity and protect the next generation.
Support recovery and avoid system re-entry.
Maintain constitutional compliance and prevent relapse.
Keep accountability visible to the people.

citizen_value.plain_language_role: Shows where recovered value goes so citizens can see how harm turns into stabilization, opportunity, and visible community benefit.
